title: Use native Liquid Glass for iPhone floating controls
body:
**Build 5 is ready for host signing and in-place install.** [Unsigned arm64 iPhone Release on nick-vm](/Users/nckrtl/apps/conn-ios-approved-screens/apps/ios/build/glass-build5/Release-iphoneos/Conn.app)

The workspace and detail footers now use native SwiftUI Liquid Glass. The selected workspace glyphs measured **6.8:1 in Dark Ocean** and **at least 9.6:1 in light**. Every sampled selected task and PR detail glyph exceeded **4.7:1**.

All four focused XCTest runs passed, covering tabs, search, settings, new chat, model selection, task and PR sections, thread controls, history jump, and edge swipe. Changed-file checks passed. The Device panel could not see the assigned simulator, so XCTest provided the interactions and captures. I removed the dedicated simulator afterward.

| Screenshots | Dark Ocean | Light |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Populated lists with filter and footer | [Dark workspace](https://github.com/nckrtl/conn/releases/download/ios-evidence-mobile-chrome/glass5-dark-workspace.png) | [Light workspace](https://github.com/nckrtl/conn/releases/download/ios-evidence-mobile-chrome/glass5-light-workspace.png) |
| Task and PR detail | [Dark detail](https://github.com/nckrtl/conn/releases/download/ios-evidence-mobile-chrome/glass5-dark-detail.png) | [Light detail](https://github.com/nckrtl/conn/releases/download/ios-evidence-mobile-chrome/glass5-light-detail.png) |
| Thread and history jump | [Dark thread](https://github.com/nckrtl/conn/releases/download/ios-evidence-mobile-chrome/glass5-dark-thread.png) | [Light thread](https://github.com/nckrtl/conn/releases/download/ios-evidence-mobile-chrome/glass5-light-thread.png) |

PR https://github.com/nckrtl/conn/pull/366, head `91a3cc3484cc88c6a0004c167a7ebde129fa94ad`, mergeable, CI pending, no reviews.
reply: Build 5 is already merged and installed on Polar. This delayed report covers the Liquid Glass update. The thread-list flicker and ordering fix is still in progress.
